title: Helios Console — Core
description: Connection and integration settings for Helios Console. Preference domain: com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.core — deploy as its own Jamf Pro Application & Custom Settings profile, scoped to all Macs running Helios. Holds the non-secret connection settings: Jamf Pro server + master client identity, optional ABM / Jamf Protect / Entra integrations, sign-in method, and local administration. All secrets are delivered separately in com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.credentials. Values override in-app Settings and take effect at app relaunch.

configurationVersion.title: Configuration Version
configurationVersion.description: Schema version for compatibility checking (informational — the loader logs it, nothing else reads it)

jamfPro.title: Jamf Pro Connection
jamfPro.description: Jamf Pro server connection and master API client identity. Required — Helios cannot operate without serverURL and masterClientID. The matching client secret is delivered in the credentials profile.

serverURL.title: Jamf Pro Server URL
serverURL.description: Full HTTPS base URL, no trailing slash. e.g. https://yourorg.jamfcloud.com

masterClientID.title: Master API Client ID
masterClientID.description: OAuth client_id of the Jamf API client used by Helios. Not secret — the paired secret is jamfProClientSecret in the credentials profile.

requiredRoleName.title: Required Jamf API Role Name
requiredRoleName.description: Jamf API Role name targeted when provisioning per-user API clients. Deliver your org's real role name; change only if the role in Jamf Pro is renamed.

vpnIPExtensionAttributeName.title: VPN IP Extension Attribute Name
vpnIPExtensionAttributeName.description: Name of the Jamf Extension Attribute holding a device's VPN IP address. When set, Screen Share and the device IP card prefer this address over the reported LAN IP. Empty = disabled (LAN IP only).

userCredentialLifetimeDays.title: User Credential Lifetime (days)
userCredentialLifetimeDays.description: Lifetime of per-user Jamf API client credentials provisioned by the app; expiry forces re-provisioning. Clamped 1-365.

eraseAckTimeoutSeconds.title: Erase Acknowledgment Timeout (seconds)
eraseAckTimeoutSeconds.description: How long every erase (Erase Device / Return to Service) waits for the device to acknowledge the ERASE_DEVICE command. Cleanup steps (Jamf record delete, Entra object delete) NEVER run without acknowledgment — on timeout the flow stops. Clamped 30-1800.

eraseAckPollIntervalSeconds.title: Erase Acknowledgment Poll Interval (seconds)
eraseAckPollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the app polls Jamf Pro for the ERASE_DEVICE acknowledgment while waiting. Clamped 5-120.

appleBusinessManager.title: Apple Business Manager (optional)
appleBusinessManager.description: Optional Apple Business Manager API connection — omit entirely if unused. The private key is delivered as abmPrivateKey in the credentials profile; ABM is configured only when clientID, keyID, and that key are all present.

enabled.title: Enable ABM
enabled.description: Enable the Apple Business Manager integration. Absent key means disabled.

clientID.title: ABM API Client ID
clientID.description: Apple Business Manager API client identifier. Not secret.

keyID.title: ABM Key ID
keyID.description: Key ID of the ABM API private key. Not secret — the PEM itself lives in com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.credentials (abmPrivateKey).

serviceType.title: Apple Service Type
serviceType.description: Which Apple service hosts your organization: business (Apple Business Manager, api-business.apple.com) or school (Apple School Manager, api-school.apple.com). Same API and token flow.

defaultMdmServerName.title: ABM Lookup — Default MDM Server Filter
defaultMdmServerName.description: Preselect the ABM Lookup server filter to this MDM server name (case-insensitive match). A starting point the operator can change — not a lock. No match = 'Any Server'.

defaultDeviceType.title: ABM Lookup — Default Device Type Filter
defaultDeviceType.description: Preselect the ABM Lookup device-type filter. A starting point the operator can change. Unrecognized values fall back to 'all'.

jamfProtect.title: Jamf Protect (optional)
jamfProtect.description: Optional Jamf Protect tenant connection for the Cleanup feature — omit entirely if unused. The API password may be delivered as jamfProtectPassword in the credentials profile (locks the in-app field); otherwise the app falls back to in-app entry stored in the Keychain.

enabled.title: Enable Jamf Protect
enabled.description: Enable the Jamf Protect integration. Absent key means disabled.

url.title: Jamf Protect Tenant URL
url.description: Full HTTPS tenant URL. e.g. https://yourorg.protect.jamfcloud.com

clientID.title: Jamf Protect API Client ID
clientID.description: Jamf Protect API client identifier. Not secret.

entra.title: Microsoft Entra Device Cleanup (optional)
entra.description: Optional Entra (Graph) cleanup for Return to Service — deletes the erased Mac's Entra device object(s) so it can re-register cleanly. Omit to disable. This block only points to a separate preference domain holding the Graph credentials; no secrets live here. The app registration needs Device.ReadWrite.All plus the Cloud Device Administrator role.

credentialDomain.title: Credential Domain (bundle identifier)
credentialDomain.description: Preference domain of the separate managed-preferences payload holding the Entra Graph credentials (admin-chosen, e.g. com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.entra). That domain must supply a tenant id, a client id, and a certificate PEM string (preferred) or client secret. An already-deployed credential plist can be reused as-is — just keep this pointer matching it.

tenantIdKey.title: Tenant ID Key (optional)
tenantIdKey.description: Exact key name to read the tenant id under in the credential domain — lets Helios reuse an existing plist as-is. If omitted, Helios tries: entra_tenant_id, tenantID, tenant_id, TenantID, entra_tenant.

clientIdKey.title: Client ID Key (optional)
clientIdKey.description: Exact key name for the client id in the credential domain. If omitted, Helios tries: entra_client_id, clientID, client_id, ClientID, entra_client.

clientSecretKey.title: Client Secret Key (optional)
clientSecretKey.description: Exact key name for the client secret in the credential domain. If omitted, Helios tries: entra_client_secret, clientSecret, client_secret, ClientSecret.

certPEMKey.title: Certificate PEM Key (optional)
certPEMKey.description: Exact key name for the certificate PEM string in the credential domain. Must be the PEM string itself, not a file path (Helios runs in user context and cannot read a root-owned PEM file). If omitted, Helios tries: entra_cert_pem, entra_certificate, cert_pem, certPEM, entra_cert, certificate_pem.

cloudInstance.title: Azure Cloud Instance
cloudInstance.description: Azure cloud for the Entra cleanup flow: global (login.microsoftonline.com / graph.microsoft.com), usgov (Azure Government / GCC High), or china (Azure operated by 21Vianet).

signIn.title: Interactive Sign-In (optional)
signIn.description: How users sign into Helios — identity only; it grants no capabilities (those live in the access domain's roles block). Omit to keep the built-in email sign-in flow. Distinct from the entra block above, which is app-only Graph cleanup credentials. FAIL-CLOSED: method=entra with missing tenant/client ids blocks sign-in rather than falling back to email.

method.title: Sign-In Method
method.description: email = built-in email sign-in (role name from the access domain's `role` key). entra = Microsoft Entra ID interactive sign-in (role names from the token's roles claim; the `role` key is ignored).

entra.title: Entra ID Sign-In
entra.description: Entra ID interactive sign-in settings. Use a separate PUBLIC-client app registration (no client secret — none is needed or used). Role capabilities are defined in the access domain, not here; a user whose token roles match no access-domain entry is refused sign-in (fail-closed). Also enable 'Assignment required' on the enterprise application Entra-side — client-side checks are a UX gate, not a security boundary.

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: Directory (tenant) ID GUID. Required when method=entra. The aliases 'common' and 'organizations' are NOT supported — issuer validation is tenant-specific. Set the real value in Jamf; never commit it to a repo.

clientId.title: Client ID (public client)
clientId.description: Application (client) id of the public-client app registration. Not secret. Required when method=entra.

cloudInstance.title: Azure Cloud Instance
cloudInstance.description: Azure cloud for interactive sign-in: global (login.microsoftonline.com), usgov (Azure Government / GCC High), or china (Azure operated by 21Vianet). Same mapping as entra.cloudInstance above — both Entra features agree on hosts per cloud.

allowedGroupIds.title: Allowed Group IDs (optional)
allowedGroupIds.description: Optional extra check: the signed-in user must belong to at least one of these Entra group object ids (GUIDs), via the token's groups claim. Empty = no check. Caveat: users in many groups get an overage token with no groups listed and will fail this check — prefer app roles, which never overage.

provisionJamfCredentials.title: Provision Jamf Credentials After Sign-In
provisionJamfCredentials.description: After Entra sign-in, provision the per-user Jamf API client from the verified email address. Disable only if per-user Jamf API clients are not wanted.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Sign-in behavior preferences, enforced in the sign-in and session views. Moved here from the ui domain — a ui profile still delivering this block is honored until you re-push, but core wins when both are present.

requireBiometric.title: Require Biometric
requireBiometric.description: Require Touch ID / biometric authentication to use the app.

allowBiometricSetup.title: Allow Biometric Setup
allowBiometricSetup.description: Allow users to enable biometric unlock in-app.

sessionTimeout.title: Session Timeout (min, 0 = none)
sessionTimeout.description: Idle session timeout in minutes. 0 disables the timeout.

allowRememberMe.title: Allow Remember Me
allowRememberMe.description: Allow the sign-in screen to remember the last operator.
